plain_text:
This report was written by Barbara-Chiara Ubaldi, Deputy Head of Division and Head of the Digital 
Government Unit, and Ricardo Zapata, Policy Analyst, under the supervision of Carlos Santiso, Head of 
the OECD Innovative, Digital and Open Government (INDIGO) Division, Public Governance Directorate. 
Elsa Pilichowski, Director for Public Governance, and Gillian Dorner, Deputy Director for Public 
Governance, advised on the strategic approach and scope.
semantic_text: This report was written by Barbara-Chiara Ubaldi, Deputy Head of Division and Head of the Digital Government Unit, and Ricardo Zapata, Policy Analyst, under the supervision of Carlos Santiso, Head of the OECD Innovative, Digital and Open Government (INDIGO) Division, Public Governance Directorate. Elsa Pilichowski, Director for Public Governance, and Gillian Dorner, Deputy Director for Public Governance, advised on the strategic approach and scope.

plain_text:
An initial draft of this report was enriched by the contributions and comments of the OECD Public
Governance Committee in October 2023, as well as from the OECD Working Party of Senior Digital
Government Officials (E-Leaders) in December 2023. The authors are thankful for the valuable comments
from Miguel Amaral, Alana Baker, Charles Baubion, Erika Bozzay, Emma Cantera, Marco Daglio, Daniel
Gerson, Pinar Guven, Andras Hlacs, Kenza Khachani, Eduardo Mangada Real de Usúa, Arturo Rivera,
Alex Seeman, and the Trade Union Advisory Committee to the OECD. Further, the report was enhanced
by the contributions from Karine Perset and Luis Aranda, among others, from the OECD Science,
Technology and Innovation Directorate. Andrea Uhrhammer provided editorial support.
